# Finance Processes

**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PM-19 | Plan Financial Management | Define how funding, costs, forecasts, and financial controls will work. | Business case, funding rules, scope, schedule, contracts, finance policy | Financial approach, cost categories, reporting cadence, thresholds | Use a cost note for low-cost work; formal controls for material or regulated funding. | Funding responsibility, cost owner, forecast source, and tolerance are clear. | Drafts approach; funding authority approves commitments. | 2.4.2.1 |
